maya: quick heads-up — hotfix PR needs 2 reviewer approvals before the release freeze in ~18m. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/7134

maya: this is the kv-cache eviction tweak (small patch), CI currently green but we need two eyes for safety/perf. one reviewer (tom) is on-call/off-hours.

tom: i'm on-call and away from a proper keyboard. can give a mobile thumbs-up for safety but can't do a deep pass right now. sorry.

ash: i can do a lightweight pass in ~10m. what are the files to hit?

maya: focus on service/kv/cache.py (eviction loop), service/kv/metrics.py (new counters), and infra/bench/kv_bench.yml (bench config). key thing: ensure no eviction stalls under concurrent set().

li: if ash + i can give quick green checks we'll meet the cutoff. i can take second eye in ~12m and run a short smoke mimic of prod traffic.

merge-bot: merge-guard: PR #7134 -> requires 2 approvals + all CI checks passing before auto-merge. Merge freeze timestamp: 1741112922. Current approvals: 0.

ash: scanned cache.py. left one inline about a minor race when set() races with eviction pointer update. not blocking, will add a tiny guard in a follow-up if we want. perf bench config looks sane.

ash: posted comment and will approve after full CI finishes.

li: ran a 5k-op smoke locally against a dev KV profile, memory and throughput look identical to main. LOG: bench run completed, p95 latency 3.2ms. leaving my approval. APPROVED

maya: thanks li. if ash approves and tom gives mobile confirm we can merge and kick a canary.

tom: mobile approve for safety (not a deep review). APPROVED :thumbsup:

ash: APPROVED — minor nit only. CI jobs just finished green.

merge-bot: merge-guard: requirements satisfied (2 approvals + CI green). Auto-merge scheduled.

maya: merging and triggering a small staging canary. will watch metrics and post if any regressions. thanks all for the quick turnaround. :coffee:
